query: How can I notice pride when I think I am helping other people?

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਹੀ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥੭॥
candidates.translation: O Lord, nothing is beyond You. I am delighted to behold You, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||7||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਲੋਗਨ; ਰਾਮੁ ਖਿਲਉਨਾ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: Some people think that the Lord is a play-thing. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਲਾਗਿ ਪਰੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਨ ਸਿਉ; ਨਹ ਚਿਤਿ ਖਸਮਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
candidates.translation: I am attached to Your gifts, but I do not even think of You, O my Lord and Master. ||3||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਸਹ ਬਾਤ. ਨ ਪੁਛੀਆ; ਕਬਹੂ. ਨ ਲਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: O my Husband Lord, You took no notice of me; You never applied me to Your feet. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ. ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦਿਤਾ; ਤਿਸੁ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
candidates.translation: He blessed you with body and soul, but you do not even think of Him.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰ ਕਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਜੋਰੁ, ਤੂ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਿਛੁ, ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਨਤਾ; ਇਹੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਹੁ, ਆਪਨ ਗਹੁ ਰੇ ॥
candidates.translation: So you think that the egotistical pride in power which you harbor deep within is everything. Let it go, and restrain your self-conceit.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮਛੀ. ਤਿਉ ਮਾਣਸਾ; ਪਵੈ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ਜਾਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: People are just like this fish; unaware, the noose of death descends upon them. ||1||Pause||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਬਹਤੀ ਜਾਤ; ਕਦੇ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ. ਨ ਧਾਰਤ ॥
candidates.translation: Your life is slipping away, but you never even notice.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਭ ਜਾਣਾ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮਾਣਾ; ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥
candidates.translation: What you think is permanent, shall all pass away. Pride is false, so become the slave of God's Saints.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ, ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਦਾ; ਦੇ ਆਪਿ ਹਥਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: In just the same way, the humble servant of the Lord loves the Lord, who extends His Helping Hand to us. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਗਰਬਿ ਗਰਬਿ; ਉਆਹੂ ਮਹਿ ਪਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: indulging in pride and egotism, he crumbles down and dissolves. ||1||Pause||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੇ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥੩॥
candidates.translation: Prays Nanak, I am satisfied forever; I have eaten the food of the Lord's Name. ||4||2||3||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਛੂਟਤ ਨਹੀ; ਕੋਟਿ ਲਖ ਬਾਹੀ ॥
candidates.translation: You shall not be saved by hundreds of thousands and millions of helping hands.

instructions: Read the complete passage before grading 0-3. Candidate order is shuffled; system identities hidden. Null means unjudged.

query: How can I serve others without expecting praise or repayment?

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲ ਹੈ; ਸੇਵਿਐ ਫਲ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧੯॥
candidates.translation: Service to the True Guru is fruitful and rewarding; serving Him, the fruits are obtained. ||19||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ; ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ॥
candidates.translation: Do seva - selfless service; follow the Guru's Teachings, and vibrate the Lord's Name, Har, Har.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹਉ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਾ; ਜਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: As Gurmukh, I shall serve You, as Guru has instructed me. ||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਤੁਮ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹੁ; ਦੂਜੀ ਸੇਵਾ. ਕਰਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਜੀ ॥
candidates.translation: Serve the Lord; do not serve anyone else.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤੀ. ਭਗਤਿ, ਨ ਹੋਵਈ; ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ. ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
candidates.translation: Without love, there is no devotion. Without the True Guru, love is not enshrined.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ; ਸੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: Whoever has good destiny inscribed on his forehead, applies himself to seva - selfless service. ||1||Pause||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
candidates.translation: And continually serve Him.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਲੈ ਬੋਲਹ; ਨਾ ਹਮ ਗੁਣ. ਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾਧੀ ॥
candidates.translation: With what mouth should I speak? I have no virtue, and I have rendered no service.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਸੇਵਾ; ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
candidates.translation: Service to the Holy is obtained by great good fortune.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
candidates.translation: Center your awareness on seva-selfless service-and focus your consciousness on the Word of the Shabad.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਊਤਮ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: Service to the True Guru is sublime, O Siblings of Destiny; through it, one's consciousness is attached to the Lord's Name. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ. ਨਾ ਪਵੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵੈ ॥੬॥
candidates.translation: He never realizes his own value, without serving the Guru. ||6||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹੁ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ; ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੈ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: O Nanak, serve the Guru, the Lord Incarnate; the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is profitable, and in the end, you shall not be called to account. ||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ. ਜਿਨੀ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ; ਸੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂੜ ਬੇਤਾਲੇ ॥
candidates.translation: Those who do not serve the Truest of the True - those self-willed manmukhs are foolish demons.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ; ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਣੀਆ ॥
candidates.translation: you shall find peace, doing seva (selfless service).

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਮੰਗੈ ਸੇਵਕੋ; ਲਾਈਆਂ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
candidates.translation: Your servant begs to serve those who are enjoined to Your service.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ. ਪਛੋਤਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
candidates.translation: Those who serve the Lord find peace; without serving Him, they regret and repent. ||15||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ. ਐਸੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ, ਕਿਆ ਓਹੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ. ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ; ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ. ਜੀਉ ਧਰੇਇ ॥
candidates.translation: O Nanak, what service can the servant perform for such a True Guru? He should offer his life, his very soul, to the Guru.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੂੰ. ਸਾਧ ਕੀ; ਹੋ. ਕਾਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: Do seva, selfless service, for the Holy Saints, and the noose of Death shall be cut away. ||1||

instructions: Read the complete passage before grading 0-3. Candidate order is shuffled; system identities hidden. Null means unjudged.

query: What passages discuss facing grief after someone I love dies?

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਸੋਚ. ਨ ਪਾਈਐ; ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਿਆਰ ॥
candidates.translation: The body does not obtain purity without loving devotion to the Lord.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਮਰੈ; ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
candidates.translation: No one dies; no one comes or goes. ||4||10||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਖਾਲੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਨੁ; ਢਹਿ ਢੇਰੀ ਤਨੁ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: The inner being is empty without love. The body shall crumble into a heap of ashes. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਮਰੈ; ਪੰਚੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਰੋਵਹਿ ॥
candidates.translation: When someone dies, the five passions meet and mourn his death.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਕੜੀਐ; ਜੇ ਅਨਿਆਇ ਕੋ ਮਰਤਾ ॥
candidates.translation: We should feel sad, if someone dies by injustice.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪਵੈ ਖੂਹਿ; ਕਿਹੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
candidates.translation: If someone's beloved friend falls into the pit, what can be used to pull him out?

candidates.gurmukhi: ਪੰਜਵੈ; ਖਾਣ ਪੀਅਣ ਕੀ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
candidates.translation: Fifth, he runs after food and drink;

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਉਪਜੈ. ਸੋ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਹੈ; ਦੁਖੁ ਕਰਿ ਰੋਵੈ ਬਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: Whoever is born shall pass away; why should we cry out in grief? ||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ. ਨ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ; ਧੰਧੈ ਧਾਈਐ ॥
candidates.translation: People do not enshrine love for the Truth; they chase after worldly affairs instead.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਪਥਰ ਕੀ ਬੇੜੀ. ਜੇ ਚੜੈ; ਭਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਬੁਡਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
candidates.translation: If someone embarks on a boat of stone, he shall drown with its cargo. ||4||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤੀ ਮਨ ਧੀਰਿ ॥੬॥
candidates.translation: The wealth of love is obtained from the Guru; through devotion, the mind becomes steady. ||6||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਜੋਰੀ; ਸੁਖ ਮਾਨਿ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: Linked to His loving devotional worship, I enjoy peace. ||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ; ਤਾ ਕੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਜੀਵਣਾ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: to live after he dies is to live a worthless life in this world. ||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਮਇਆ ਦਇਆ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੂਰਨ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਗਨ ਹੋਤ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: Bestow Your mercy and compassion, O merciful and perfect Lord, that Nanak may be intoxicated with Your Love. ||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੇ ਮੂਆ; ਚਾਲਤ ਕੁਲ ਕੀ ਕਾਨਿ ॥
candidates.translation: Kabeer, the mortal dies of his worldly troubles and pain, after worrying about his family.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੁ ਮਰੈ ਤਉ ਨਾਰਿ ਨ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
candidates.translation: When her husband dies, the woman does not cry.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰਹੁ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੋ ਨੇਂਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: O God, ocean of mercy, shower Your mercy on me, that I may yearn for loving devotional worship of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

instructions: Read the complete passage before grading 0-3. Candidate order is shuffled; system identities hidden. Null means unjudged.

query: How can I respond to fear about an uncertain future?

candidates.gurmukhi: ਭੈ. ਨਿਰਭਉ ਮਾਣਿਅਉ; ਲਾਖ ਮਹਿ. ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਯਉ ॥
candidates.translation: In the Fear of God, You enjoy the Fearless Lord; among the thousands of beings, You see the Unseen Lord.

candidates.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
candidates.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

candidates.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ. ਸਭੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ; ਨਿਰਭਉ. ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸੋਇ ॥
candidates.translation: The entire universe is in fear; only the Dear Lord is fearless.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਭੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ. ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ; ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਮਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
candidates.translation: He Himself is the Commander; all are under His Command. The Fearless Lord looks on all alike. ||3||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਸਚਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਇ; ਨਿਰਭਉ. ਭੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
candidates.translation: Hereafter, Truth is the Name of all; the Fearless Lord has no fear at all.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ. ਕੇਤੇ ਨਿਸਤਰੇ; ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
candidates.translation: Through the Fear of the Guru, many have been saved; in this fear, find the Fearless Lord.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਡਰਿ ਡਰਿ ਡਰਣਾ; ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸੋਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: Afraid of fear, and living in fear, the mind is held in tumult. ||1||Pause||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਰਚਿ ਰਹੈ; ਸੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
candidates.translation: Those who remain immersed in the Fear of God become fearless.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਤੇ; ਨਿਰਭਉ ਡਰਤਾ ਫਿਰੈ ॥
candidates.translation: The fearless are afraid of fear.

candidates.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
candidates.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

candidates.gurmukhi: ਛਲ ਬਪੁਰੀ ਇਹ ਕਉਲਾ ਡਰਪੈ; ਅਤਿ ਡਰਪੈ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
candidates.translation: This miserable deceiver Maya abides in the Fear of God; the Righteous Judge of Dharma is utterly afraid of Him as well. ||3||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਅਨਭਉ. ਤਹ ਭੈ ਨਹੀ; ਜਹ ਭਉ. ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
candidates.translation: Where the Fearless Lord is, there is no fear; where there is fear, the Lord is not there.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ; ਸਚੁ ਏਕੁ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: O Nanak, the Fearless Lord, the Formless Lord, the True Lord, is One. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜਪੈ; ਸਗਲ ਭਉ ਮਿਟੈ ॥
candidates.translation: Meditating on the Fearless Lord, all fear departs.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਤੇ. ਨਿਰਭਉ ਪਾਈਐ; ਜਿਸ ਦਾ. ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
candidates.translation: Through the Fear of God, the Fearless Lord is found; He has no end or limitation.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਭਉ. ਤਿਨੑ ਨਾਹਿ ਭਉ; ਮੁਚੁ ਭਉ. ਨਿਭਵਿਆਹ ॥
candidates.translation: Those who have the Fear of God, have no other fears; those who do not have the Fear of God, are very afraid.

instructions: Read the complete passage before grading 0-3. Candidate order is shuffled; system identities hidden. Null means unjudged.

query: What does Gurbani say about responding to an insult without anger?

candidates.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੈ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: The Gurmukh speaks the Ambrosial Word of Gurbani. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਰਸੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੪॥
candidates.translation: O Nanak, the Ambrosial Nectar of Gurbani rains down; the Lord, in His Grace, has come into the home of my heart. ||4||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ; ਮਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
candidates.translation: Constantly listening to the Ambrosial Gurbani in the heart, it becomes pleasing to the mind.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ; ਅਵਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਥੋਰਾ ॥
candidates.translation: Without the Lord's Name, everything else is useless.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ. ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ; ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਗੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
candidates.translation: Practicing fraud and falsehood, she suffers terrible pain; without the True Guru, she does not find the way.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਚੜੈ ਦਿਵਸੁ. ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਗਾਵੈ; ਬਹਦਿਆ ਉਠਦਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
candidates.translation: Then, at the rising of the sun, he is to sing Gurbani; whether sitting down or standing up, he is to meditate on the Lord's Name.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵਰਖੈ; ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
candidates.translation: The Ambrosial Nectar, the Unstruck Melody of Gurbani rains down continually;

candidates.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ, ਦਯਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਰਖੵਾ ਕਰੋਤਿ ॥੪੭॥
candidates.translation: O Destroyer of the pains of the poor, O Merciful God, Nanak prays for You to protect all begins from such anger. ||47||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ. ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ; ਕਰਮਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: Gurbani is the Light to illuminate this world; by His Grace, it comes to abide within the mind. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ. ਤਤੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ; ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਈ ॥
candidates.translation: The Ambrosial Word of Gurbani proclaims the essence of reality. Spiritual wisdom and meditation are contained within it.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਵਸਹਿ; ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
candidates.translation: Within this body dwell the five thieves: sexual desire, anger, greed, emotional attachment and egotism.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ. ਸਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਹੈ; ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਬਣੀਐ ॥
candidates.translation: The Word of the True Guru's Bani is the embodiment of Truth; through Gurbani, one becomes perfect.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ; ਨਾਮ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
candidates.translation: In it is the Glory of God, the Naam, the chanting of Gurbani.

instructions: Read the complete passage before grading 0-3. Candidate order is shuffled; system identities hidden. Null means unjudged.

query: How should I think about earning a living honestly?

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟਿ ਚਲੈ; ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
candidates.translation: One who departs, after earning the wealth of the Lord's Name,

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਖਟੇ; ਲਖ ਕਉ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
candidates.translation: Earning a thousand, he runs after a hundred thousand.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸੰਚੇ ਸੰਚਿ. ਨ ਦੇਈ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ; ਅੰਧੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਭ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
candidates.translation: People gather and hoard their possessions, and give nothing to anyone else - the poor fools think that everything is theirs.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਲਾਭ; ਮਨੋਰਥ ਲਾਧੇ ॥
candidates.translation: earning huge profits and seeing one's desires fulfilled

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਸੰਚਉ ਹਉ ਖਾਟਤਾ; ਸਗਲੀ ਅਵਧ ਬਿਹਾਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: "I am earning profits, I am getting rich", he says, as his life passes away. ||Pause||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਮੁਏ; ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ. ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukhs are in a living death; forgetting the Lord, they suffer in pain. ||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ; ਤਜਿ ਲਾਜ ਲੋਕਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: Dedicate your mind and body to Him; stop living to please others. ||1||Pause||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ; ਬਹੁਤੈ ਧਨਿ ਖਾਟੇ ॥
candidates.translation: There is no peace in earning lots of money.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਰੰਗ ਰੂਪ ਰਸ; ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਲੈ ਲਾਹਿਓ ॥੨॥੭॥੨੬॥
candidates.translation: O Treasure of Mercy, Nanak savors Your Love and Your Blissful Form, earning the Profit of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||7||26||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: Earning the Profit of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I am intuitively absorbed in the Naam. ||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਝੁ. ਵਖਰੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ; ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੋ ॥
candidates.translation: Other than this, I can think of no other merchandise. So chant the Naam each and every moment.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਣੰਜਹਿ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ; ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
candidates.translation: They trade lovingly in the Lord's Name, and depart after earning the profit of the Lord's Name.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਜੀਅ; ਤੇਤੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
candidates.translation: There are just as many traders as there are living beings.

instructions: Read the complete passage before grading 0-3. Candidate order is shuffled; system identities hidden. Null means unjudged.

query: Are there passages about treating people equally despite status or wealth?

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗ ਰਾਮ ਜਨ ਊਤਮ; ਮਿਲਿ ਊਤਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
candidates.translation: The Lord's people are the most lofty and exalted. Meeting with them, the most exalted status is obtained.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੪੮॥੧੧੭॥
candidates.translation: Says Nanak, they attain the supreme status. ||4||48||117||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਜੋਬਨੁ; ਪੰਜੇ ਠਗ ॥
candidates.translation: Royal power, wealth, beauty, social status and youth are the five thieves.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਚਹਿ ਦਰਬੁ; ਦੇਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਲੋਗ ॥
candidates.translation: You gather wealth by exploiting people.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਸਮ ਦਲ; ਸਮਝਾਵੈ ਕੋਊ ॥੩॥
candidates.translation: O Ravi Daas, one who understands that the Lord is equally in all, is very rare. ||3||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾ ਪਰਜਾ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਰੈ; ਐਸੋ ਕਾਲੁ ਬਡਾਨੀ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: The king and his subjects are equally killed; such is the power of Death. ||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਸਭ ਪੇਖਿ ਸਮਾਨੋ; ਮੁਖਿ ਬਕਨੋ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: They look upon all equally, the high and the low; they speak of Him with their mouths, and honor Him in their minds. ||1||Pause||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ; ਮਿਲਿ ਪਰਮਾਰੰਥ ॥੬॥
candidates.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the supreme wealth is obtained. ||6||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਤ ਦਰਸੁ. ਪਾਪ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਸਹਿ; ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all my sins are erased, and I obtain the supreme, sublime, sanctified status. ||1||Pause||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ. ਤੂ ਵਸਹਿ; ਤੇ ਨਰ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: But those, within whose hearts You dwell, O Lord - those people are oceans of virtue. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਆਚਾਰ ਕਰਹਿ; ਸੋਭਾ ਮਹਿ ਲੋਗ ॥
candidates.translation: you practice good conduct to impress people;

candidates.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਬਿਨੁ; ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
candidates.translation: Tell me, without this wealth, who has ever obtained the supreme status? ||4||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਤੇ, ਕਿਹ ਪਦਹਿ ਅਮਰਿਓ; ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਸੇਖ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: From such a low social status, what a high status he obtained! Devotional worship to the Lord is sublime! ||1||Pause||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖਾ ਇਕੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ; ਗੁਰ ਮਿਤਾ ਪੁਤਾ ਭਾਈਆ ॥
candidates.translation: The Guru loves all of His Gursikhs equally well, like friends, children and siblings.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਜ ਰੰਕ ਕਉ; ਲਾਗੈ ਤੁਲਿ ਪਵਾਨ ॥
candidates.translation: like the wind, which blows equally upon the king and the poor beggar.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਅਨਰਥ; ਵਿਹਾਝੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
candidates.translation: oppressing the people, he gathers wealth.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਮੁਕੰਦੁ; ਦੁਰਬਲ ਧਨੁ ਲਾਧੀ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: Mukanday is the wealth of the poor and forlorn. ||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਜਾਤਿ. ਉਤਮੁ ਭਇਆ; ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਪਏ ਪਗਿ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: Although he was of low social status, he was exalted and elevated, and people of all four castes came and bowed at his feet. ||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ. ਤੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ; ਤੇ ਊਤਮ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੋਗ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੦॥
candidates.translation: Celebrated are those people, unto whom the Lord seems sweet; how exalted are those people of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||3||10||

instructions: Read the complete passage before grading 0-3. Candidate order is shuffled; system identities hidden. Null means unjudged.

query: How are outward religious practices different from inner devotion?

candidates.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਨੈ; ਉਸ ਤੇ ਕਹਾ ਛਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
candidates.translation: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows everything; how can we hide anything from Him? ||3||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਦੈਤ ਪੁਤੁ. ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੰਜਮ ਨ ਪੜੈ; ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ. ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
candidates.translation: The demon's son Prahlaad had not read about religious rituals or ceremonies, austerity or self-discipline; he did not know the love of duality.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਬਸੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
candidates.translation: One whose inner being is filled with the Formless Lord

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਸੂਰ. ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਅਉਧੂ; ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੩॥
candidates.translation: Contemplating the Shabad, you shall be a hero throughout the four ages, O hermit; contemplate the Word of the Guru's Bani in devotion. ||23||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਕੀ; ਸੂਲ ਨ ਸਹਹੁ ॥੭॥
candidates.translation: and you will not have to endure the torture of karma or religious rituals. ||7||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਕੁਲ ਸੰਜੁਗਤੁ ਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ. ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
candidates.translation: One who performs the six religious rituals and comes from a good family, but who does not have devotion to the Lord in his heart,

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸਦ ਹੀ; ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
candidates.translation: He truly practices Truth forever; true devotion is implanted within him. ||4||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਭਿਖਿਆ; ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਚਲੈ ॥
candidates.translation: He begs for loving devotion to the Lord, and lives in the Fear of God.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਿਖ ਸੰਤ ਸਮਝਾਈ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ. ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥੫॥੧॥੨॥
candidates.translation: Nanak instructs the Saints to teach, that the mind is imbued with loving devotion to the Lord. ||5||1||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹਿ; ਖਿੰਥਾ ਬਹੁ ਥਟੂਆ ॥
candidates.translation: You wear religious robes, and your patched coat assumes many disguises.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ. ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਤ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ; ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੫॥੫੬॥
candidates.translation: Says Kabeer, meeting with the Guru, I have obtained supreme joy; my love and devotion have saved me. ||4||1||5||56||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸੁਚ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਹਿ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
candidates.translation: He practices religious rituals, purity and austere self-discipline, but within, there is greed and corruption.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਸਿਧ ਆਸਣ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ; ਏ ਭੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
candidates.translation: He practices the eighty-four postures of Yoga, and acquires the supernatural powers of the Siddhas, but he gets tired of practicing these.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ; ਸਭੁ ਭਾਉ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੭॥
candidates.translation: Religious rituals and daily worship services lead only to the love of duality. ||7||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ. ਭਗਤਿ ਇਕ ਬਾਢੀ; ਅਬ ਇਹ ਕਾ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
candidates.translation: Says Ravi Daas, my devotion to the One Lord is increasing; now, who can I tell this to?

candidates.gurmukhi: ਬਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਕਰਮ ਖਟ ਕੀਨੇ; ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੇਖ ਦਿਖਾਵਾ ॥
candidates.translation: Others go on fasts, take vows, perform the six rituals and wear religious robes for show.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਚਲਣੁ. ਅਉਰੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ; ਊਂਹਾ. ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: Hereafter, the way is different, O Siblings of Destiny. There, these things are of no use at all. ||1||

instructions: Read the complete passage before grading 0-3. Candidate order is shuffled; system identities hidden. Null means unjudged.

query: How can I care for my family without becoming consumed by attachment?

candidates.gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗ ਸ੍ਨੇਹੰ; ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਸੁਤਹ ॥
candidates.translation: Cursed is attachment to the joys of family life with one's spouse and children.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੋਭਾਣਾ; ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
candidates.translation: Beholding your family, you are lured away by emotional attachment, but when you leave, they will not go with you.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮੈ. ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ; ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ॥੯॥੧੬॥
candidates.translation: Without You, I have no other at all; please, bless me with Your Glance of Grace. ||9||16||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ; ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਜੀਵਾਇਆ ॥
candidates.translation: Through pain and pleasure, you have taken care of your family.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ; ਨਿਤ ਗਰਬਿ ਫਿਰਾਮੀ ॥
candidates.translation: Their minds are imbued with attachment to family, and so they continually wander around, puffed up with pride.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਾਰਉ ਐਸੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਨਬੰਧੀ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰੀ ॥
candidates.translation: Burn away any love of family and relatives, which increases your attachment to Maya.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਉ; ਫਿਰਿ. ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥
candidates.translation: So serve the Guru, and you shall not be consumed by death.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਆਵਦਾ; ਸਭੁ ਚਲਣਹਾਰਾ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
candidates.translation: Emotional attachment to your family and everything you see is temporary, coming and going.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ; ਤਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: and if, becoming humble, she serves Him, then she becomes dear to her Beloved's Heart. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਪਚੇ ਪਚਿ; ਅੰਧਾ ਮੂਆ ॥੩॥
candidates.translation: But, engrossed in attachment, the blind fool wastes away to death. ||3||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਗਿਰਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਉਦਾਸੀ; ਗਿਆਨ ਤਤ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
candidates.translation: Immersed in family life, the Lord's humble servant ever remains detached; he reflects upon the essence of spiritual wisdom.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ; ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭ ਕਾਰ ॥
candidates.translation: Your attachment to your family, your attachment to all your affairs

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧਾ. ਤਪਿ ਤਪਿ ਖਪੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ. ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
candidates.translation: The blind, self-willed manmukh is consumed by his burning rage; without the Word of the Shabad, peace is not obtained.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ; ਕੜੇ ਕੜਿ ਪਚਿਆ ॥
candidates.translation: In love and attachment to Maya, the mortals are sad, and are consumed by sadness.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਧ; ਨ ਪਾਈਐ. ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
candidates.translation: Without the Holy Saint, association with the Lord is not obtained.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਗਲਾ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਮਸਲਤਿ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ. ਹਮਾਰੀ ਕਰਦਾ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
candidates.translation: My conversation is with the Lord's Name, and my counseling is with the Lord's Name; the Lord's Name always takes care of me.

instructions: Read the complete passage before grading 0-3. Candidate order is shuffled; system identities hidden. Null means unjudged.

query: What passages address wanting more possessions even when I have enough?

candidates.gurmukhi: ਏਕਹਿ; ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਪਿੰਡ ਤੇ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
candidates.translation: Some love this wealth even more than their body and breath of life.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜੋਰੇ ਲਾਖ ਕ੍ਰੋਰੇ; ਮਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਰੇ ॥ ਪਰੈ ਪਰੈ ਹੀ ਕਉ; ਲੁਝੀ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: People may accumulate hundreds of thousands, millions, tens of millions, and yet the mind is not restrained. They only yearn for more and more. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਦਾਰਾ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਸਗਲ; ਜਿਨਿ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿ ॥
candidates.translation: Your wealth, spouse, and all the possessions which you claim as your own

candidates.gurmukhi: ਰੂਪੀ ਭੁਖ. ਨ ਉਤਰੈ; ਜਾਂ ਦੇਖਾਂ ਤਾਂ ਭੁਖ ॥
candidates.translation: Beauty does not satisfy hunger; when the man sees beauty, he hungers even more.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਆਰਜਾ; ਹੋਰ ਦਸੂਣੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
candidates.translation: Even if you could live throughout the four ages, or even ten times more,

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸੰਪੈ ਹੇਤੁ; ਕਲਤੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੇਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: The possessions and the spouse to which the mortal is lovingly attached, are Your wealth, O Lord. ||1||Pause||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਪੰਚ ਸੂਰਬੀਰ; ਐਸੋ ਕਉਨੁ ਬਲੀ ਰੇ ॥
candidates.translation: Who has seized and conquered the five powerful fighters? Is there anyone strong enough?

candidates.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਆਪਨ ਥਾਪਿਓ, ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ. ਨ ਨਿਮਖ ਜਾਪਿਓ; ਅਰਥੁ ਦ੍ਰਬੁ ਦੇਖੁ. ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ, ਨਾਹੀ ਚਲਨਾ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: You claim that your body and wealth are your own; you do not chant the Lord's Name even for an instant. Look and see, that none of your possessions or riches shall go along with you. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਾਣੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਰਣੁ, ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: The wretched creature does not even think of death. ||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਨਾਨਕ; ਪੀਵਤੰ. ਸੰਤ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪੵਤੇ ॥੨੬॥
candidates.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is Ambrosial Nectar, O Nanak. The Saints drink it in, and never have enough of it. ||26||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਘਣੋ ਘਣੋ ਘਣੋ ਸਦ ਲੋੜੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਲਹਣੇ. ਕੈਠੈ ਪਾਇਓ ਰੇ ॥
candidates.translation: More and more, he continually yearns for more; but unless he is destined to receive, how can he obtain it?

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਲੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ; ਖਟੇ ਦੰਮ ਸਹੰਮੀ ॥੨੯॥
candidates.translation: Whatever he takes, he does not give back. Seeking to earn more and more, he is troubled and uneasy. ||29||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ; ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਬਹੁ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
candidates.translation: O Merciful to the meek, save me. I have wandered enough; now I am tired.

instructions: Read the complete passage before grading 0-3. Candidate order is shuffled; system identities hidden. Null means unjudged.

query: How can I stay humble when I succeed at something?

candidates.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ; ਕਹ ਲਉ ਸਿਧੀਆ ॥
candidates.translation: but without the One Name, how far can they succeed?

candidates.gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਆ; ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਤ ਨ. ਕਾਮ ॥
candidates.translation: Engrossed in the three qualities, one's efforts do not succeed.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਿਛੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਗਨਿਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: It seems that I have learned something of the science of Yoga. ||Pause||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ; ਜੀਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਾਮ ਕਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: Here and hereafter, God is forever your Help and Support. He is your soul-mate; He will help you succeed. ||1||Pause||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਹੂ ਨ ਸੀਝਈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਪਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: - O Nanak, he shall never succeed. Without the Name, he shall lose his honor. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸੁਲਹੀ ਕਾ ਹਾਥੁ ਕਹੀ. ਨ ਪਹੁਚੈ; ਸੁਲਹੀ ਹੋਇ ਮੂਆ ਨਾਪਾਕੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: The emperor did not succeed in his plot, and he died in disgrace. ||1||Pause||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ. ਨ ਜੀਵਣਾ; ਵਿਸਰੇ ਸਰੈ ਨ. ਬਿੰਦ ॥
candidates.translation: O Nanak, without Him, we could not live for a moment. Forgetting Him, we could not succeed for an instant.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਜਾ ਜਾਨੈ; ਹਉ ਕਛੁ ਹੂਆ ॥
candidates.translation: JAJJA: When someone, in his ego, believes that he has become something,

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ ਅਵਗਿਆ ਜਨ ਕੀ; ਹੋਇ ਗਇਆ ਤਤ ਛਾਰ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: Whoever shows disrespect to the Lord's humble servant, is instantly reduced to ashes. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ. ਉਠਿ ਚਲਣਾ; ਬੁਝੁ ਸਬਦ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
candidates.translation: How can he stay here? He must get up and depart. Contemplate the Word of the Shabad, and understand this.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਰ ਚਾਹਤ ਕਛੁ ਅਉਰ; ਅਉਰੈ ਕੀ ਅਉਰੈ ਭਈ ॥
candidates.translation: The man wishes for something, but something different happens.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨਿ ਤੇ ਵੈ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ; ਜਿਨ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: Blessed are those silent sages and humble beings, who meditate on my Lord God. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨੈ; ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: As something pleases my Lord and Master, in that I find my glory. ||1||

instructions: Read the complete passage before grading 0-3. Candidate order is shuffled; system identities hidden. Null means unjudged.

query: What does remembering Naam mean in ordinary daily life?

candidates.gurmukhi: ਏਹੀ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਜਪ ਏਹੀ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੈ ਰੀਤਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: This is my karma and my Dharma; this is my meditation. The Lord's Name is my immaculate, unstained way of life. ||Pause||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਬੇ ਨਿਵਾਜਾ ਕੁਤਿਆ; ਏਹ. ਨ ਭਲੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
candidates.translation: Fareed: O faithless dog, this is not a good way of life.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਦੇਵਾ. ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੇਵਾ; ਇਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: True living is serving the Divine, Supreme Lord God; the Guru has imparted this teaching to me. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ; ਜੀਵਨੁ ਮਨ ਹੀਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: Without the Lord's Name, life is mindless. ||1||Pause||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ; ਦੋਖ ਸਭਿ ਲਾਥੇ ॥
candidates.translation: Remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all sinful mistakes are erased.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ; ਭਗਤ ਕਉ ਦੀਨ ॥੮॥੧੧॥
candidates.translation: is blessed with the treasure of the Naam. ||8||11||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਓਟ ॥
candidates.translation: The Name of the Lord is the Support of His servants.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸਿਮਰਿ ਰਤਨਾਗਰੁ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: Remember in meditation the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the source of jewels. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮੰਗਲ ਰੂਪ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਜੀਵਨ ਧਨ; ਸਿਮਰਤ ਅਨਦ ਘਨਾ ॥
candidates.translation: God is the Embodiment of bliss, the Breath of Life and Wealth; remembering Him in meditation, I am blessed with absolute bliss.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ. ਉਬਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ; ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੭੧॥
candidates.translation: Nanak is saved, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord; in the True Court, he is cheered and applauded. ||4||3||171||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਇਸਟੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਭੰਡਾਰੈ ॥੨॥੨॥੭॥
candidates.translation: The Naam is Nanak's dearest friend; the Lord's Name is my treasure. ||2||2||7||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਕੋਟਿ ਲਖ ਪੂਜਾ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਤੁਲਿ. ਨ ਲਾਇਣ ॥
candidates.translation: Hundreds of thousands and millions of meditations, austerities and worships are not equal to remembering the Lord in meditation.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਜੋਰੁ ਹੈ; ਅਗੈ ਜੀਉ ਨਵੇ ॥
candidates.translation: In the world hereafter, social status and power mean nothing; hereafter, the soul is new.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ; ਜਿ. ਜੀਵਨ ਜੀਆ ॥
candidates.translation: Why forget Him, who is the Life of the living beings?

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੇ. ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ; ਸਦ ਜੀਵਨ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
candidates.translation: God gave me His Hand and saved me; He has blessed me with eternal life.

instructions: Read the complete passage before grading 0-3. Candidate order is shuffled; system identities hidden. Null means unjudged.

query: Does accepting Hukam mean that I should stop making an effort?

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮਰੈ; ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੀ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
candidates.translation: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, they die; by the Hukam of His Command, they live.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝੈ; ਸੋ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
candidates.translation: One who understands the Hukam of Your Command is absorbed in Truth.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨੇ, ਸੋ ਭਗਤੁ ਹੋਇ; ਵਿਣੁ ਮੰਨੇ. ਕਚੁ ਨਿਕਚੁ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: O Nanak, one who accepts the Will of the Lord is His devotee. Without accepting it, he is the falsest of the false. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ. ਹੁਕਮੁ, ਨ ਮੰਨਈ; ਤਾ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
candidates.translation: O Nanak, if one does not obey the Hukam of the Lord's Command, then within one's own home, the Lord seems far away.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੋਆ; ਹੁਕਮੇ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: The Hukam of the Lord's Command is pervasive; by the Hukam of His Command, all things happen. ||1||Pause||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ. ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
candidates.translation: Whoever understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command, realizes the essence of reality.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਰਾਹ ਚਲਾਏ. ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਬਾਏ; ਜਨਮਿ ਮੁਆ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
candidates.translation: All follow these two paths, by the Hukam of the Lord's Command; the world is born, only to die.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ. ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਝੈ; ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command; the Lord showers His Mercy upon him. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ; ਸਭੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
candidates.translation: Accepting the Hukam of the Lord's Command, he is blessed with all virtues and spiritual wisdom.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ. ਨ ਬੂਝੈ, ਖਸਮ ਕਾ; ਸੋਈ ਨਰੁ ਕਚਾ ॥
candidates.translation: One who does not understand the Hukam, the Command of his Lord and Master, is false.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਬੇੜੁ; ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
candidates.translation: He judges each and every being; by the Hukam of His Command, He leads us on.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਆਇਆ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
candidates.translation: By His Command we come, and by His command we merge into Him again.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਲਗਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ; ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
candidates.translation: Without serving the Lord, he suffers in pain; accepting the Hukam of God's Command, pain is gone.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ. ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਬਪੁੜੇ; ਭੂਲੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
candidates.translation: The wretched fools do not know the Lord's Will; they wander around making mistakes.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ, ਉਤਮੁ ਨੀਚੁ; ਹੁਕਮਿ ਲਿਖਿ, ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ॥
candidates.translation: By His Command, some are high and some are low; by His Written Command, pain and pleasure are obtained.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ਸਾਹ ਕਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
candidates.translation: If he comes to realize the Command of the Lord's Will, O Beloved, then he is blessed with Truth and Honor. ||6||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਇਕੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
candidates.translation: The Hukam, the Command of the One Lord is all-pervasive; accepting it, peace is found. ||3||

instructions: Read the complete passage before grading 0-3. Candidate order is shuffled; system identities hidden. Null means unjudged.

query: How does the company I keep influence my mind?

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੁ ਨਚਣਾ; ਖੁਸੀਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: other dances produce only temporary pleasure in the mind. ||1||Pause||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ. ਨ ਪ੍ਰਬੋਧੇ ॥
candidates.translation: Without the Name, this mind is not awakened.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਆਸ; ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
candidates.translation: Keep faith in the One Lord within your mind.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ; ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
candidates.translation: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, under the influence of the three dispositions, were put to their tasks.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਨ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
candidates.translation: In the Company of the Holy, the mind does not wander.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਿ; ਕਬਹੂ. ਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
candidates.translation: In my mind, I never sang the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜੇ. ਦੇਹੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਈਐ; ਪਾਪ ਗਰਹ ਦੁਇ ਰਾਹੁ ॥
candidates.translation: If my body were afflicted with pain, under the evil influence of unlucky stars;

candidates.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਭੇ ਰੋਗਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ; ਮਮਤਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: All those under the influence of the three qualities are afflicted with the disease; through possessiveness, they lose their awareness. ||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਖਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭੀ ਤੂ ਹੈ ॥੭॥
candidates.translation: The Gurmukh sees You ever-present; You are deep within the nucleus of our inner self. ||7||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਸਿਖ ਦੇਇ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ. ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਜਾਲੇ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: Nanak gives this advice: O beloved mind, in the Company of the Holy, burn away your doubts. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਮੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਊ ਗੁਨੁ; ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥੨॥੬॥
candidates.translation: O servant Nanak, I have no virtues at all; keep me in Your Sanctuary, Lord. ||2||6||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
candidates.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord with your tongue, O mind.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ. ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ; ਸਰਸੇ ਸਜਣ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
candidates.translation: My mind is in ecstasy; I have met my Beloved Lord. My beloved friends, the Saints, are delighted.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
candidates.translation: Meditate, O my mind, on the Lord, Raam, Raam, with love.

instructions: Read the complete passage before grading 0-3. Candidate order is shuffled; system identities hidden. Null means unjudged.

query: What guidance is there about showing kindness to someone I dislike?

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਰਾਖੇ; ਭਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: Showing His Mercy, the Lord Himself has protected me, and all my works have been brought to fruition. ||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ. ਅਪੁਨਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਕੀਨੋ; ਕਾਟੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਫਾਧਿਓ ॥
candidates.translation: Showing His Mercy, the Lord has made me His slave, and shattered the bonds of Maya.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਇਆ; ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ਅਗਨਈ ॥
candidates.translation: One who is blessed with Your Kindness, is not touched by fire.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਹਰਿ ਪਰਗਟੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
candidates.translation: Showing His Mercy, the Lord has revealed Himself to me.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ; ਨਦਰੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: If the Lord grants His Grace, then we come to meet the True Guru. By His Kindness, we are united in His Union. ||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਓਹੁ; ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨੑਾਵੈ ॥
candidates.translation: Someone may bathe at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage,

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਰਾਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਲਾਜ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: Showing His Mercy, the Lord Himself protects our honor. ||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵਿਸਟੁ ਮੇਲਿ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ. ਕਰਿ ਰੈਬਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
candidates.translation: Unite me with the True Guru, Your Advisor, O my Lord of the Universe; through His guidance, He shall lead me to the Lord.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਖਾਤ ਪੀਤ ਖੇਲਤ; ਹਸਤ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
candidates.translation: Eating, drinking, playing, laughing and showing off

candidates.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਛੇ; ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਗਾ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: Seeking the Guru's guidance, my mind is content. ||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਦੇਖਿ ਪਰਾਈ ਚੋਪੜੀ; ਨਾ ਤਰਸਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੯॥
candidates.translation: Fareed, if you see someone else's buttered bread, do not envy him for it. ||29||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਕੀਨੋ; ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋਰਿ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥
candidates.translation: Showing His Mercy, the Lord has made me His slave; breaking my bonds, He has saved me.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ; ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜੇ ਕਰੈ ॥
candidates.translation: But if the Compassionate Saint shows His Kindness,

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਚਰਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲੀ ॥
candidates.translation: Showing His Mercy, He joins her with His Feet,

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹਉ. ਪੰਥੁ ਦਸਾਈ ਨਿਤ ਖੜੀ; ਕੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਸੇ. ਤਿਨਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: I stand by the wayside and ask the Way. If only someone would show me the Way to God-I would go with him.

instructions: Read the complete passage before grading 0-3. Candidate order is shuffled; system identities hidden. Null means unjudged.

query: How can awareness of death change the way I spend my time?

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਊਪਜੈ; ਫੂਟਿ ਮਰੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: That person, within whose heart the Lord's Name does not well up - may that person burst and die! ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰਾ. ਮਰਤਾ ਮਰਤਾ ਜਗੁ ਮੁਆ; ਮਰਿ ਭਿ. ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
candidates.translation: Kabeer, the world is dying - dying to death, but no one knows how to truly die.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਤਉ ਜਰੇ ਮਰੇ. ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਲੀਨੋ ਹਾਥਿ ਸੰਧਉਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: Now that you have taken up the challenge of death, let yourself burn and die, and attain perfection. ||1||Pause||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਨਿਤ; ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਕੇਰਿਆ ॥
candidates.translation: They die, and are re-born, and die, over and over again. They are of no use at all!

candidates.gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਮਰਨੇ ਜੋ ਮਰੈ; ਬਹੁਰਿ. ਨ ਮਰਨਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨੯॥
candidates.translation: Let those who die, die such a death, that they shall never have to die again. ||29||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਜਮੁ ਧਾਇ ਕੇਸ ਗਹਿ ਮਾਰੈ; ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਹੀ. ਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਲ ਗਇਆ ॥੩॥
candidates.translation: When the Messenger of Death grabs you by your hair, you will be punished. You are unconscious, and have fallen into Death's mouth. ||3||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਮਰੈ; ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
candidates.translation: No one dies; no one comes or goes. ||4||10||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮਰਣੁ. ਨ ਮੰਦਾ ਲੋਕਾ ਆਖੀਐ; ਜੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਐਸਾ ਕੋਇ ॥
candidates.translation: Death would not be called bad, O people, if one knew how to truly die.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ. ਐਸੀ ਮਰਨੀ ਜੋ ਮਰੈ; ਤਾ ਸਦ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: O Nanak, one who dies such a death, lives forever. ||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮੋਇਆ ਰੋਂਹਿ; ਰੋਂਦੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਂਹਂੀ ॥
candidates.translation: The weepers who weep for the dead shall themselves die as well.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਅਉਸਰਿ. ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗੁਣ ਰਮਣ ਜਿਤੁ; ਕੋਟਿ ਮਜਨ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
candidates.translation: This is the time to speak and sing the Praise and the Glory of God, which brings the merit of millions of cleansing and purifying baths.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮਰਣ ਜੀਵਣ ਕਉ ਧਰਤੀ ਦੀਨੀ; ਏਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਸਰੇ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: To die and to live, He gave us the earth, but we have forgotten these blessings. ||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਕੈਸੇ ਮਰਉ; ਮਰਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
candidates.translation: Now, how shall I die? My mind has already accepted death.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਰਹਿ; ਮਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਵਿਗਾੜਹਿ ॥
candidates.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are dying; they are wasting away in death.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਸੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਦਿਖਾਏ ॥
candidates.translation: Meeting the True Guru, we are shown the way to die.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮਰਤੀ ਬਾਰ; ਅਗਨਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਲੀ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: but at the time of death, it is burned in the fire. ||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਭਾਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਮ. ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਮਰਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੫॥੨॥
candidates.translation: I have searched, but I have found no way to remain here; so, remain dead while yet alive. ||5||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮਰਤਾ ਜਾਤਾ; ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੪॥
candidates.translation: and now I see that there is no such thing as birth or death. ||4||4||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮੁਇਆ. ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ; ਤਿਤੁ ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਮਰੁ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
candidates.translation: To reach your True Home after you die, you must conquer death while you are still alive.

instructions: Read the complete passage before grading 0-3. Candidate order is shuffled; system identities hidden. Null means unjudged.

query: Are there passages about letting go of resentment?

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਚਿਤੁ. ਨ ਚਲੈ; ਮਨੁ ਭਇਓ ਪੰਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: My consciousness does not go out wandering. My mind has become crippled. ||1||Pause||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਰਾਮੁ, ਨ ਛੋਡੀਐ; ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਾਇ ਤ ਜਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: Kabeer, do not abandon the Lord; your body and wealth shall go, so let them go.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਪੁਤੁ ਕਲਤ੍ਰੁ ਲਖਿਮੀ ਦੀਸੈ; ਇਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਿਛੂ. ਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੀਆ ॥
candidates.translation: You look upon your children, spouse and wealth; none of these will go along with you.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮਰਹਟ ਲਗਿ, ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਮਿਲਿ; ਹੰਸੁ ਇਕੇਲਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: All the people and relatives together go to the crematorium, but the swan-soul must go home all alone. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਬਾਮਨ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਰਾਂਡੀ ਆਛੈ; ਰਾਂਡੀ ਸਾਂਡੀ ਹਾਂਡੀ ਗੋ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: In the Brahmin's home there are widows. So here they are: haandee, saandee, raandee. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ. ਨ ਚਾਲੈ; ਸਮਝ ਲੇਹ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: - none of them shall go along with you; you must know that this is true! ||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ; ਏਕ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
candidates.translation: but not even one will go along with you in the end.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਵਲੁ ਛਲੁ ਕਰਿ. ਝਤਿ ਕਢਦੇ; ਫਿਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਬਹਹਿ. ਕੂੜਿਆਰਾ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
candidates.translation: By hook or by crook, they pass their time, and then they go back to sit with the false ones again.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਏਸ ਨੋ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਕਿ ਖਵਾਲੀਐ; ਜਿ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
candidates.translation: Why feed it by telling lies? When you leave, it does not go with you.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਭਰਮਿ; ਭੂਲਉ ਮਤਿ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
candidates.translation: Let no one go astray in doubt like me. ||3||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ. ਪੂਛਿ ਚਲਉ ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ; ਜਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ. ਤਹ ਹੀ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੧੦॥
candidates.translation: O Nanak, I will go and ask my Guru; wherever God is, there I will go. ||10||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸੰਚੰਤਿ. ਬਿਖਿਆ ਛਲੰ ਛਿਦ੍ਰੰ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ. ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲਤੇ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: One may gather poison through deception and fraud, O Nanak, but without the Lord, nothing shall go along with him in the end. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਧਨੁ. ਮੇਰੈ ਸਾਥਿ ਚਾਲੈ; ਜਹਾ ਹਉ ਜਾਉ ਤਹ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
candidates.translation: The Lord is my wealth, which shall go with me; wherever I go, it will go. ||3||

instructions: Read the complete passage before grading 0-3. Candidate order is shuffled; system identities hidden. Null means unjudged.

query: How does Gurbani describe searching for understanding while experiencing doubt?

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਾਗਤ ਸੂਤਾ; ਭਰਮਿ ਵਿਗੂਤਾ ॥
candidates.translation: The mortal sleeps, even while he is awake; he is being plundered by doubt.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਜੋਤਕੀ ਥਕੇ; ਭੇਖੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
candidates.translation: The Pandits and the astrologers read and read until they grow weary, while the fanatics are deluded by doubt.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਿਛੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਵਰਨੀਐ; ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰਿਖਾ ॥
candidates.translation: If He were a material object, then I could describe Him, but He has no form or feature.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ; ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: Understanding his own self, he meets God. ||1||Pause||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਭਰਮੁ, ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਇਆ; ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਹਲੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨॥
candidates.translation: Says Nanak, when the Guru drives out doubt, then the soul-bride enters the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||4||3||12||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਤਿੰਨਾ. ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਭੇਦੁ ਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ॥੭॥
candidates.translation: They have no doubt or sense of separation - their tongues taste the divine taste. ||7||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਇਹੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ; ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
candidates.translation: Searching and searching, I have come to this realization: all peace and bliss are in the Name of the Lord.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹਿ, ਨ ਸਕਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਹਮ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਹ ਅਭਾਗੀ ॥੩॥
candidates.translation: I cannot describe Your state and extent. O God, how can we unfortunate ones meet with You? ||3||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਅਉਰ ਦੁਨੀ ਸਭ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨੀ; ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਨ ਮਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
candidates.translation: All the rest of the world is deluded by doubt, while my mind is intoxicated with the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||4||3||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
candidates.translation: Says Nanak, the Guru has dispelled my doubt. ||4||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਏ; ਹਮ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਰਿਆ ॥੭॥
candidates.translation: I have found God - I am not searching for any other. ||7||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਮੈ ਫਿਰਾ; ਖੋਜਉ ਬਨ ਥਾਨ ॥
candidates.translation: Searching, searching, I wander around searching, in the woods and other places.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ. ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੀ; ਫਾਵੀ ਹੋਈ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
candidates.translation: Deluded by doubt, I wandered over the whole world. Searching, I became frustrated.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰੁ ਭਾਲੇ, ਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਲਹੈ; ਵਥੁ ਘਰੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
candidates.translation: Searching outwardly, what can anyone find? The commodity is deep within the home of the self, O Siblings of Destiny.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ; ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: The Gurmukhs are saved, while the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਹਉ ਕਥੀ. ਕਥੇ ਕਥਿ ਦੇਖਾ; ਮੈ. ਅਕਥੁ, ਨ ਕਥਨਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
candidates.translation: What should I say? While talking, I talk of seeing, but I cannot describe the indescribable.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਗਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ. ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੨॥੫॥੯੧॥
candidates.translation: I have sought His Sanctuary, and grasped hold of the Lord's Lotus Feet; God has helped Guru Nanak to understand this understanding. ||2||5||91||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਕਰਤ; ਜਨਮਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਮੂਆ ॥
candidates.translation: Experiencing pain and pleasure, one is born, only to die again.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ. ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ; ਬੁਝਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮੀਤਾ ॥
candidates.translation: Meeting the True Guru, one remains dead while yet alive; understanding Him, he is absorbed in the Truth.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਭਵੀ. ਨ ਬੁਝਈ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
candidates.translation: Their intellect and understanding are perverted; they just don't understand. They are filled with greed and corruption.

instructions: Read the complete passage before grading 0-3. Candidate order is shuffled; system identities hidden. Null means unjudged.

query: What passages discuss a restless mind that keeps wandering?

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੋੁਬਿੰਦੇ ॥
candidates.translation: Meditate, O mind, on the Naam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇ ਮਿਲੈ; ਕਿਨਿ. ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੭॥
candidates.translation: If one surrenders his mind upon meeting the True Guru, who can estimate its value? ||7||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਲਾਗਤੀ; ਤਾਲਾਬੇਲੀ ॥
candidates.translation: I am restless and unhappy.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਧਾਤੁਰ ਬਾਜੀ. ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ; ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥੧੨॥
candidates.translation: Restrain your restless wanderings through the Shabad, and the Naam will come to dwell in your mind. ||12||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਲੋਭੀ; ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
candidates.translation: O greedy mind - listen, O my mind!

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਦੇ; ਰਾਮੁ ਲੀਆ ਹੈ ਮੋਲਿ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: But I have bought the Lord by giving my mind to Him. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਤੇ; ਧਾਵਤੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: Since then, my restless mind has been satisfied. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਧਾਇਓ ਰੇ ਮਨ; ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਇਓ ॥
candidates.translation: The mind wanders, wandering in the ten directions.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ. ਮਨੁ ਹੀ ਜਾਨੈ; ਕੈ ਬੂਝਲ ਆਗੈ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
candidates.translation: The mind alone knows the state of the mind; I tell it to the Knowing Lord.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੋਈ. ਅਵਰੁ, ਨ ਕੋਈ; ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ. ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
candidates.translation: He is All-pervading; there is no other. The mind comes to believe, from the mind.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ; ਤਾਂ ਉਤਰੀ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥੪॥
candidates.translation: Says Nanak, I met the Perfect Guru, and then the anxiety of my mind was removed. ||4||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਨ ਮੈ. ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋਊ; ਨਾਰਾਇਨੁ ਜਿਹ ਚੀਤਿ ॥੨੪॥
candidates.translation: Among millions, O Nanak, there is scarcely anyone, who keeps the Lord in his consciousness. ||24||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀ. ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਰਹੀ ॥
candidates.translation: The mind remains in the mind.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਨਦਰੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਖਦਾ; ਜੇਤੀ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਕੀਤੀ ॥
candidates.translation: He keeps all under His Gaze; He created the entire Universe.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਚੰਚਲ ਮਨੁ. ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਕਉ ਧਾਵਤ; ਅਚਲ ਜਾਹਿ ਠਹਰਾਨੋ ॥
candidates.translation: The restless mind wanders in the ten directions - it needs to be pacified and restrained.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕੈਸੇ ਮਨ ਤਰਹਿਗਾ ਰੇ; ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬਿਖੈ ਕੋ ਬਨਾ ॥
candidates.translation: O my mind, how will you cross over the world-ocean, if you are filled with the water of corruption?

candidates.gurmukhi: ਚਲ ਚਿਤ ਜੋਗੀ; ਆਸਣੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
candidates.translation: Your consciousness is restless, Yogi, as you sit in your Yogic postures.

query: What is the relationship between personal effort and grace?

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਗੁਸਾਈ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
candidates.translation: The Lord, the Lord of the Earth, the Lord of the Universe, in His Mercy, leads me to meet the Holy Person, the Guru.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨੇਮੁ ਨਿਬਾਹਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ; ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
candidates.translation: My vows have been honored, by the Grace of God and the True Guru, who has showered His Mercy. ||3||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਵਸਹੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ; ਹੋਇ ਸਹਾਈ ਆਪਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: Bestow Your Mercy, and dwell within my heart; please, become my Helper. ||1||Pause||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ. ਕੋਈ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ; ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
candidates.translation: Without serving the True Guru, no one obtains it. It is obtained only by Guru's Grace. ||4||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ; ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਰੁਚਿ. ਨ ਬਢਾਈ ॥
candidates.translation: God is Merciful to the meek, forever the Destroyer of fear, and yet you do not develop any loving relationship with Him.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਫਕੜ ਜਾਤੀ; ਫਕੜੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: Pride in social status is empty; pride in personal glory is useless.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੂਟੇ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: The chains of all my hopes and desires have been snapped; my Lord God has showered me with His Mercy. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: God is pervading the water, the land and the sky; He sees all with His Glance of Grace. ||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੈ, ਜੀਵਤ ਸੋਈ ਮਰੈ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਤਰੈ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੋ ਜਨੁ; ਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਝੀ ਹੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫੪॥
candidates.translation: Those, unto whom the Lord shows His Mercy, remain dead while yet alive. In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, they cross over the ocean of Maya. O Nanak, those humble beings are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||4||1||154||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਧਰਤੀ ਚੀਜੀ ਕਿ ਕਰੇ; ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
candidates.translation: What are personal possessions to the earth, from which all things are produced?

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਤੁ ਆਹਰਿ ਜਗੁ ਉਧਰੈ; ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: O Nanak, how rare are those who understand the effort which saves the world. ||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਖੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਈ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
candidates.translation: Those who are blessed by Your Kind Mercy, meet the Almighty Lord, and find the Guru.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ. ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਮਾਗੈ; ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੮॥੨॥
candidates.translation: Nanak, the song-bird, begs for the Ambrosial Water; O Lord, shower Your Mercy upon him, and bless him with Your Praise. ||8||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੀ ਪਿਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ; ਮੈ ਛੋਡਿਅੜਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
candidates.translation: She answers, "My True Husband blessed me with His Mercy; I abandoned the distinction between mine and yours.

query: haumai kiven ghat kariye

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ. ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਮਨ; ਗੁਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਣੁ ਲੈ ਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: Subdue your ego, and contemplate Him in your mind; gather in the virtues of the Sublime, Virtuous Lord. ||1||Pause||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਤਾ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
candidates.translation: The Gurmukh conquers his mind by subduing his ego.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਦੀਰਘ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ; ਦਾਰੂ ਭੀ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
candidates.translation: Ego is a chronic disease, but it contains its own cure as well.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
candidates.translation: False are ego, possessiveness and Maya.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਹੈ; ਅਤਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
candidates.translation: Ego, self-centeredness, excessive anger and pride are the lot of mankind.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
candidates.translation: They bathe in it continually, day and night, and the filth of ego is washed away. ||4||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਿਚਰੁ. ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਹਰੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
candidates.translation: As long as his mind is disturbed by waves, he is caught in ego and egotistical pride.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਹਿ. ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ; ਤਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: If you submit to the Hukam of the Lord's Command, then you shall meet with the Lord; only then will your ego depart from within. ||Pause||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਤੀਣੇ; ਤਾਰਾ ਚੜਿਆ ਲੰਮਾ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: O Nanak, killing his ego, he is satisfied; the meteor has shot across the sky. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ; ਤਾ ਦਰੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
candidates.translation: When one understands ego, then the Lord's gate is known.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ; ਜਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਟਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
candidates.translation: In this world, one who knows God is very rare; eradicating ego, he is absorbed in God.

query: bina phal di ichha seva karni

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰਹਿ. ਫਿਰਿ ਨਾ ਮਰਹਿ; ਤਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਵੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਇ ॥
candidates.translation: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad shall never have to die again; his service is totally approved.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੂੰ. ਸਾਧ ਕੀ; ਹੋ. ਕਾਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: Do seva, selfless service, for the Holy Saints, and the noose of Death shall be cut away. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹੁ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ; ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੈ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: O Nanak, serve the Guru, the Lord Incarnate; the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is profitable, and in the end, you shall not be called to account. ||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
candidates.translation: Center your awareness on seva-selfless service-and focus your consciousness on the Word of the Shabad.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ; ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: Service to the Holy brings lasting peace and bliss. ||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ; ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ॥
candidates.translation: Do seva - selfless service; follow the Guru's Teachings, and vibrate the Lord's Name, Har, Har.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹਉ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਾ; ਜਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: As Gurmukh, I shall serve You, as Guru has instructed me. ||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ; ਨਿਹਫਲ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: Without devotional worship of the Lord, service is useless. ||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਮੰਗੈ ਸੇਵਕੋ; ਲਾਈਆਂ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
candidates.translation: Your servant begs to serve those who are enjoined to Your service.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ; ਜੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
candidates.translation: The mortal works to serve the True Guru, if he walks in harmony with the True Guru's Will.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ; ਸੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: Whoever has good destiny inscribed on his forehead, applies himself to seva - selfless service. ||1||Pause||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੀ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਨੁ ਹੋਇ, ਸੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਘਾਲੇ ॥
candidates.translation: Service to the True Guru is immaculate and pure; those humble beings who are pure perform this service.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਤੁਮ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹੁ; ਦੂਜੀ ਸੇਵਾ. ਕਰਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਜੀ ॥
candidates.translation: Serve the Lord; do not serve anyone else.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ; ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਣੀਆ ॥
candidates.translation: you shall find peace, doing seva (selfless service).

query: hukam mannna ki hai

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ. ਹੁਕਮੁ, ਨ ਮੰਨਈ; ਤਾ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
candidates.translation: O Nanak, if one does not obey the Hukam of the Lord's Command, then within one's own home, the Lord seems far away.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਰਹੈ ਰਜਾਈ; ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
candidates.translation: Understanding the Hukam of His Command, one acts according to His Will.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਜੋ ਬੁਝੈ; ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਚੁ ॥
candidates.translation: O Nanak, one who realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command, obtains the fruit of Truth.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ; ਭਾਣੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
candidates.translation: Birth and death are subject to the Command of the Lord's Will; through His Will we come and go.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਉਤਕੁ. ਕਾਲੁ ਇਹੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਪਠਾਇਆ ॥
candidates.translation: You issue Your Command for this amazing thing, death.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਾਜੇ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਢਾਹੇ; ਹੁਕਮੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
candidates.translation: By the Hukam of Your Command, You create, and by Your Command, You destroy. By Your Command, You unite in Union. ||5||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੋਆ; ਹੁਕਮੇ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: The Hukam of the Lord's Command is pervasive; by the Hukam of His Command, all things happen. ||1||Pause||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਹਿ. ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ; ਤਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: If you submit to the Hukam of the Lord's Command, then you shall meet with the Lord; only then will your ego depart from within. ||Pause||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਆਇਆ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
candidates.translation: By His Command we come, and by His command we merge into Him again.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨਾਥੁ. ਸਭ ਨਥੀਅਨੁ; ਸਭ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਈ ॥
candidates.translation: He Himself is the Lord and Master of all. He has subdued all, and all are under the Hukam of His Command.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ. ਹੁਕਮੁ, ਨ ਜਾਤੋ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ; ਜਿ ਰਹਾ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: O Nanak, I do not know my Lord and Master's Command, by which I would merge in the Truth. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਇਕਨੑਾ. ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਲਏ; ਇਕਨੑਾ. ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਰੇ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
candidates.translation: By His Command, some are merged into Him, and some, by His Command, are destroyed.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ. ਨ ਬੂਝੈ, ਖਸਮ ਕਾ; ਸੋਈ ਨਰੁ ਕਚਾ ॥
candidates.translation: One who does not understand the Hukam, the Command of his Lord and Master, is false.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੫॥
candidates.translation: By His Command, the Lord, Har, Har, abides within our minds; by His Command we merge in Truth. ||5||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ. ਹੁਕਮੁ, ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਅਗੈ ਕਾਈ ਕਾਰ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: O Nanak, one who does not understand the Hukam of God's Command - what will he have to do in the world hereafter? ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਰਾਹ ਚਲਾਏ. ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਬਾਏ; ਜਨਮਿ ਮੁਆ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
candidates.translation: All follow these two paths, by the Hukam of the Lord's Command; the world is born, only to die.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ. ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਝੈ; ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command; the Lord showers His Mercy upon him. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮਰੈ; ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੀ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
candidates.translation: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, they die; by the Hukam of His Command, they live.

query: roz de kam vich naam simran

candidates.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ; ਸੁਣਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਖਾਲਕਾ ॥੧੧॥
candidates.translation: Please bless me with Your Name, O my Beloved Lord God; please listen to my prayer, O Creator. ||11||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਭਜਨੁ ਦਇਆ. ਨਹੀ ਕੀਨੀ; ਤਉ ਮੁਖਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਹਿਗਾ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: You do not remember the Lord, or vibrate upon Him in meditation, and you do not practice compassion; you shall be beaten on your face. ||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸਿਮਰਿ ਰਤਨਾਗਰੁ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: Remember in meditation the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the source of jewels. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
candidates.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, meditate in remembrance on God's Name.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ. ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮ ॥
candidates.translation: remember the Name of the Lord of the Universe in your mind.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹਰਿ; ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
candidates.translation: Remember, remember in meditation the Lord, the Creator, the Cause of causes.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
candidates.translation: Make this meditative remembrance of the Lord's Name your Support.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਬਿਨੁ; ਬੂਡਤੇ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: Without remembering the Lord's Name in meditation, a great many are drowned. ||1||Pause||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਪੀੜੀ ਚਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ; ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
candidates.translation: Age after age, the Family of the True Guru shall increase. As Gurmukh, they meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ; ਫਿਰਿ. ਬਹੁੜਿ. ਨ ਧਾਈ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: O Nanak, remember in meditation the One Name, and you shall never again be consigned to the womb of reincarnation.. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ; ਜਿਨ ਆਪਿ ਸਿਮਰਾਏ ॥
candidates.translation: They alone remember Him in meditation, whom He inspires to meditate.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮਹਮਾ ਨਾਮ. ਕਹਾ ਲਉ ਬਰਨਉ; ਰਾਮ ਕਹਤ. ਬੰਧਨ ਤਿਹ ਤੂਟਾ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: How much can I describe the Glorious Praises of the Naam? Whoever chants the Lord's Name, his bonds are broken. ||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਤ ਘਰੀ ਚਸਾ ਪਲੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ. ਰਸਨਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਉ ॥
candidates.translation: Remember Him in meditation, for an hour, for a moment, even for an instant. Chant the Name of the Lord with your tongue.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਨ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮ ॥
candidates.translation: Meditate in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ; ਦੋਖ ਸਭਿ ਲਾਥੇ ॥
candidates.translation: Remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all sinful mistakes are erased.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ; ਭੈ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ; ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
candidates.translation: Repeating the Naam, the Name of the Lord, no obstacles block the way.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ; ਜਨੁ ਤਾਰਿਓ ॥
candidates.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, His servant has been carried across.

query: man di shanti kiven mile

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੇ. ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ; ਜਿਨਾ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: O Nanak, they are united with the Word of the Shabad; serving the Lord, the Great Giver, they shall never be separated from Him again. ||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ. ਰਾਮ ਮਿਲੇ; ਭ੍ਰਮ ਦੂਰੇ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
candidates.translation: O Nanak, they merge into the Lord, and their doubts are cast away. ||4||11||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ; ਪਾਇਆ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੨੫॥
candidates.translation: Says Nanak, the Divine Light has dawned within my mind; I have obtained the state of Nirvaanaa. ||4||4||125||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਲਣਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ; ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਉਪਜੀ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥
candidates.translation: The fire of desire is cooled and quenched; my mind and body are filled with peace and tranquility.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਨਰ ਬਿਛੁਰੇ. ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ; ਨਾ ਦਿਨ ਮਿਲੇ. ਨ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੧੨੫॥
candidates.translation: Those who are separated from the Lord do not meet Him in the day, or in the night. ||125||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਿ ਸਜਣਾ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
candidates.translation: Those Gurmukhs who meet as friends are blessed with the Lord God's Love.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ; ਮਨਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
candidates.translation: I have met my Lord and Master, and my desires are fulfilled; my mind chants His Immaculate Mantra.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮਨ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਦਹੂੰ ॥
candidates.translation: O my mind, chant forever the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੇ. ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ; ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਪਰਤੈ ॥੨੪॥
candidates.translation: One who meets the True Guru meets the Lord; no one can turn him away. ||24||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਕੋਸਰੋ. ਸਿਧਿ ਕਰਤ ਲਾਲੁ; ਤਬ ਚਤੁਰ ਪਾਤਰੋ ਆਇਓ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: When my Beloved used to go even a mile away, He would send me four letters. ||Pause||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮੰਝਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਲਾ; ਪਿਰੀ ਤਹਿਜਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: Nanak: with Your Name within my mind, O my Husband Lord, I am filled with delight. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ. ਕਾਰਜ ਸਾਰੇ; ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
candidates.translation: God, my Beloved, has met me, and my affairs are all resolved. The Creator Lord knows all ways and means.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਿਲੇ; ਪਲਟਿ ਭਈ ਸਭ ਖੇਹ ॥੧੭੯॥
candidates.translation: Without meeting the Guru, the Lord of the Universe, they are all reduced to dust again. ||179||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮਨੁ ਛੂਟਿ ਗਇਆ; ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲੇ ॥
candidates.translation: My mind is now emancipated; I have joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੇ; ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
candidates.translation: Meeting the True Guru, they find Truth, and merge into the True Name. ||3||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਏਹਿ ਸਜਣ ਮਿਲੇ. ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ; ਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
candidates.translation: These friends are united, and will not be separated again; they have been united by the Creator Lord Himself.

query: moh ate pyaar vich ki farak hai

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ, ਰਤਨ ਜਵਾਹਰ ਮਾਣਿਕ; ਜੇ ਇਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣੀ ॥
candidates.translation: Within the mind are gems, jewels and rubies, if you listen to the Guru's Teachings, even once.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਏਕ ਹੈ; ਆਪੇ ਫਰਕੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
candidates.translation: The One Lord grants His Grace to all; He Himself makes distinctions.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਲੈ. ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਕਿ ਏਹੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਿ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
candidates.translation: Meeting with the Holy, the perfection of the Siddhas is obtained. What good is Yoga or indulgence in pleasures?

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਬੇੜਾ ਜਰਜਰਾ; ਤਬ ਉਤਰਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਹਉ ਫਰਕਿ ॥੬੭॥
candidates.translation: When I saw that my boat was rotten, then I immediately got out. ||67||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ. ਫਰਕੁ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਆਪੇ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: He Himself instills the sense of separation within our hearts; He Himself created the Creation. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਨਾਲੋ ਤੁਟੀ ਭਲੀ; ਜਿਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: O Nanak, it is good to break away from the self-willed manmukhs, who have love and attachment to Maya. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਜੀਅ. ਜੀਵਹਿ ਲੈ ਸਾਹਾ; ਜੀਵਾਲੇ. ਤਾ ਕਿ ਅਸਾਹ ॥
candidates.translation: All beings and creatures live by breathing, but He could keep us alive, even without the breath.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਧਨਹੀਣੁ ਹੈ; ਅਗੈ ਭੁਖਾ ਕਿ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukhs of the world lack this wealth; when they are hungry in the next world, what will they have to eat there? ||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਧਰਤੀ ਚੀਜੀ ਕਿ ਕਰੇ; ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
candidates.translation: What are personal possessions to the earth, from which all things are produced?

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੰਮੁ ਹੈ. ਤਿਚਰੁ, ਨ ਚੇਤਈ; ਕਿ ਕਰੇਗੁ ਅਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
candidates.translation: As long as there is breath in the body, he does not remember the Lord; what will he do in the world hereafter?

candidates.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ. ਜੇ ਮੈ ਹੋਦਾ ਵਾਰਿਆ; ਮਿਤਾ ਆਇੜਿਆਂ ॥
candidates.translation: Fareed, if I had been there when my friend came, I would have made myself a sacrifice to him.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਸਿਰ. ਕਾਤੀ ਮੁੰਨੀਅਨਿੑ; ਗਲ ਵਿਚਿ. ਆਵੈ ਧੂੜਿ ॥
candidates.translation: those heads were shaved with scissors, and their throats were choked with dust.

query: Will it rain in Toronto tomorrow?

candidates.gurmukhi: ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲਿੑ. ਤਜਿ ਜਾਹੁਗੇ; ਜਿਉ ਕਾਂਚੁਰੀ ਭੁਯੰਗ ॥੪੦॥
candidates.translation: Today or tomorrow, you will have to leave it behind, like the snake shedding its skin. ||40||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ. ਐਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ; ਜੈਸੀ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਮੇਹ ॥
candidates.translation: O mind, love the Lord, as the song-bird loves the rain.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਉਪਜਿਓ. ਸੋ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਹੈ; ਪਰੋ ਆਜੁ ਕੈ ਕਾਲਿ ॥
candidates.translation: Whatever has been created shall be destroyed; everyone shall perish, today or tomorrow.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਕਾਲਿ ਕਰੰਤਾ. ਅਬਹਿ ਕਰੁ; ਅਬ ਕਰਤਾ. ਸੁਇ ਤਾਲ ॥
candidates.translation: Kabeer, that which you have to do tomorrow - do it today instead; and that which you have to do now - do it immediately!

candidates.gurmukhi: ਆਖੀਂ ਸੇਖਾ ਬੰਦਗੀ; ਚਲਣੁ ਅਜੁ ਕਿ ਕਲਿ ॥੯੭॥
candidates.translation: O Shaykh, dedicate yourself to God; you will have to depart, today or tomorrow. ||97||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲਿੑ ਭੁਇ ਲੇਟਣਾ; ਊਪਰਿ ਜਾਮੈ ਘਾਸੁ ॥੩੮॥
candidates.translation: Today or tomorrow, you shall lie beneath the ground, and the grass shall grow above you. ||38||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਭਿੰਨੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਚਮਕਿਆ; ਵੁਠਾ ਛਹਬਰ ਲਾਇ ॥
candidates.translation: The night is wet with dew; lightning flashes, and the rain pours down in torrents.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਲੁ ਸਭ ਤੈ ਵਰਸਦਾ; ਵਰਸੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
candidates.translation: This rain pours down on all; it rains down in accordance with God's Loving Will.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ. ਅਜੁ ਕਲਿ ਆਵਸੀ; ਗਾਫਲ ਫਾਹੀ ਪੇਰੁ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: O Nanak, today or tomorrow, the feet of the careless fool shall fall into the trap. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਭਿਜਉ ਸਿਜਉ ਕੰਬਲੀ; ਅਲਹ ਵਰਸਉ ਮੇਹੁ ॥
candidates.translation: My blanket is soaked, drenched with the downpour of the Lord's Rain.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗੇ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਫੜੈ; ਮਿਲਿ ਮੇਘ ਧਰ ਸੁਹਾਗ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: My mind blossoms forth in the Society of the Saints; soaking up the rain, the earth is blessed and beautified. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਤੋਹਿ ਗ੍ਰਸਿ ਹੈ; ਸਮਝਿ ਰਾਖਉ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
candidates.translation: Today or tomorrow, eventually it will seize you; understand this in your consciousness.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ. ਗਾਗਰਿ ਜਲ ਭਰੀ; ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲਿੑ. ਜੈਹੈ ਫੂਟਿ ॥
candidates.translation: Kabeer, the pitcher is full of water; it will break, today or tomorrow.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਮਝੁ ਰੇ ਇਆਨੇ; ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਖੁਲੑੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਾਂਠੁਲੀ ॥੨॥੩੮॥੬੧॥
candidates.translation: Says Nanak: figure it out, you ignorant fool! Today or tomorrow, the knot will be untied! ||2||38||61||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਵੁਠੇ ਮੇਘ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੇ; ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
candidates.translation: Rain is falling from the clouds - it is so beautiful! The Creator Lord issued His Order.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਚਲਣੁ ਅਜੁ ਕਿ ਕਲਿੑ; ਧੁਰਹੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: One must depart, today or tomorrow, according to the Lord's Primal Order. ||2||
