query: Which stock will double in price next week?

candidates.gurmukhi: ਨਹੀ ਪਟਣੁ. ਨਹੀ ਪਾਰਖੂ; ਨਹੀ ਗਾਹਕੁ. ਨਹੀ ਮੋਲੁ ॥੨੩॥
candidates.translation: There is no market to sell it, no appraiser, no customer, and no price. ||23||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਤੋ ਪਹਿ. ਦੁਗਣੀ ਮਜੂਰੀ ਦੈਹਉ; ਮੋ ਕਉ ਬੇਢੀ ਦੇਹੁ ਬਤਾਈ ਹੋ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: I shall pay him double wages. Tell me, who is your carpenter?" ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਪਾਰਖੂ; ਤਬ ਹੀਰਨ ਕੀ ਸਾਟ ॥੧੬੨॥
candidates.translation: As soon as an appraiser is found, the price of the jewel is set. ||162||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ. ਨ ਪਾਈਆ; ਕਿਤੈ. ਨ ਲਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
candidates.translation: No one can evaluate Him; He cannot be purchased at any price.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮਾਹੁ ਪਖੁ. ਕਿਹੁ ਚਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ; ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੰਢੈ ॥
candidates.translation: It will not last for a month, or even a week. It barely lasts for an hour, or even a moment.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ. ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲੈ ਵਤੈ ਕਾ ਬੀਜਿਆ; ਭਗਤ; ਖਾਇ ਖਰਚਿ ਰਹੇ, ਨਿਖੁਟੈ, ਨਾਹੀ ॥ ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੈ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੩॥
candidates.translation: The devotees of the Lord plant the seed of the Lord's wealth in the ambrosial hours of the Amrit Vaylaa; they eat it, and spend it, but it is never exhausted. In this world and the next, the devotees are blessed with glorious greatness, the wealth of the Lord. ||3||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਵਾਰ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ੭ ॥
candidates.translation: Raag Gauree, The Seven Days Of The Week Of Kabeer Jee:

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੈਗੋ ਗਾਹਕੀ; ਲੇਗੋ ਮਹਗੇ ਮੋਲਿ ॥੨੨੫॥
candidates.translation: If a buyer can be found, it will go for a high price. ||225||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਭਿ ਦਿਹ; ਸਭਿ ਥਿਤੀ ਸਭਿ ਵਾਰ ॥
candidates.translation: All nights, all days, all dates, all days of the week;

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮਰਣਿ. ਨ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਪੁਛਿਆ; ਪੁਛੀ ਥਿਤਿ ਨ ਵਾਰੁ ॥
candidates.translation: Death does not ask the time; it does not ask the date or the day of the week.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਕੀ; ਓਹੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
candidates.translation: understands this world and the next.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹੁਰਮਤਿ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਅਗਲੀ; ਓਹੁ ਵਜਹੁ ਭਿ ਦੂਣਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
candidates.translation: his honor increases, and he receives double his wages.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਪੰਦ੍ਰਹ ਥਿਤਂੀ; ਤੈ ਸਤ ਵਾਰ ॥
candidates.translation: The fifteen lunar days, the seven days of the week,

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਡੇਖੈ ਹਿਕ ਵਾਰ; ਤਾ ਸੁਖ ਕੀਮਾ ਹੂ ਬਾਹਰੇ ॥੩॥
candidates.translation: If You look at me, even for an instant, then I obtain peace beyond all price. ||3||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ; ਨਿਬਹੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: In this world, and the next, He shall stand by you. ||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮੋੁਲਿ ਅਮੋੁਲੁ. ਨ ਪਾਈਐ; ਵਣਜਿ. ਨ ਲੀਜੈ ਹਾਟਿ ॥
candidates.translation: Priceless virtues are not obtained for any price; they cannot be purchased in a store.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਧ ਇਆਣੀ ਦੁੰਮਣੀ; ਸੂਹੈ ਵੇਸਿ ਲੋੁਭਾਇ ॥
candidates.translation: She who loves to wear her red dress is foolish and double-minded.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਪੰਦ੍ਰਹ ਥਿਤੰੀ ਸਾਤ ਵਾਰ ॥
candidates.translation: There are fifteen lunar days, and seven days of the week.

query: Find the exact line that says success is guaranteed if I meditate for seven days.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਪੰਦ੍ਰਹ ਥਿਤੰੀ ਸਾਤ ਵਾਰ ॥
candidates.translation: There are fifteen lunar days, and seven days of the week.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਧੰਨਿ ਤੇ ਜਨ; ਜਿਨੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
candidates.translation: Blessed are those humble beings, who are imbued with love for His Praises, and who meditate single-mindedly on Him.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਰੈਨਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ; ਤਜਹੁ. ਮਨ ਕੇ ਭਰਮ ॥
candidates.translation: Night and day, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har; abandon the doubts of your mind.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ; ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਾਝ ਸਵੇਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: Remember Him, meditate on Him, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, day and night, evening and morning. ||1||Pause||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਵਾਰ ਸਤ ਘਰੁ ੧੦ ॥
candidates.translation: Bilaaval, Third Mehl, The Seven Days, Tenth House:

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸਿਮਰਿ ਰਤਨਾਗਰੁ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: Remember in meditation the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the source of jewels. ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ; ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੩॥
candidates.translation: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord Master, the Searcher of hearts; O Nanak, He is the One, pervading and permeating all. ||3||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਨ ਜੋਗੁ; ਕਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
candidates.translation: Practice Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਬਿ ਕਲ. ਸੁਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਉ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ; ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਣਿਓ ॥੨॥
candidates.translation: KAL the poet sings the Sublime Praises of Guru Nanak, who enjoys mastery of Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success. ||2||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਵਾਰ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ੭ ॥
candidates.translation: Raag Gauree, The Seven Days Of The Week Of Kabeer Jee:

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ; ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
candidates.translation: Meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance of Him, and find peace.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ. ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ; ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
candidates.translation: Meditate on the Lord's Name, and you shall find peace; your stay in this world shall last only four days.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
candidates.translation: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; meditate on it continually.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਸੋ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ, ਨਿਤ ਕਰ ਜੁਰਨਾ ॥
candidates.translation: He shall give you peace, O my mind; meditate forever, every day on Him, with your palms pressed together.

candidates.translation: Give us your true opinion, Nanak." ||19||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥ ਸਨਾਥ ਸੰਤਨ; ਕੋਟਿ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
candidates.translation: He is the Master of the masterless, the Supporting Lord of the Saints, the Neutralizer of millions of sins.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਆਪੀਨੑੈ ਆਪੁ ਸਾਜਿਓਨੁ; ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਥੰਮਿੑ ਖਲੋਆ ॥
candidates.translation: He created Himself, and He Himself is the supporting pillar.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਕਲੋਲ ਬੁਝਹਿ. ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
candidates.translation: Please shower Your Mercy upon me, and permit me to ignore the great enticements of Maya, O Lord, Merciful to the meek.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਮਨ; ਆਦਿ ਗੁਣ ਆਦਿ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ॥
candidates.translation: Within my mind, I chant the Name of the Primal Lord God, the Source of virtue.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਲਉਡਾ; ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਆ ਅਜਾਤਿ ॥
candidates.translation: That slave, whom God has released from the restrictions of social status

candidates.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਹ ਨਾਮੁ; ਤਜਿ ਲਾਜ ਲੋਕਾਣੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
candidates.translation: Night and day, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and ignore the criticism of others. ||1||Pause||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਸਉਦਾਗਰੀ; ਸਤੁ ਘੋੜੇ ਲੈ ਚਲੁ ॥
candidates.translation: Let your trade be listening to scripture, and let Truth be the horses you take to sell.

candidates.gurmukhi: ਲੇਖਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਅਲੇਖੈ ਛੂਟਹ; ਹਮ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
candidates.translation: Please ignore my account; only then may I be saved. I am worthless - please, save me! ||1||

candidates.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਿ; ਬਲਹਰ. ਨਾ ਠਾਹਰੈ ॥
candidates.translation: As the house will not stand when the supporting beams are removed from within it,

candidates.gurmukhi: ਕਵਣ ਮੂਲੁ; ਕਵਣ ਮਤਿ ਵੇਲਾ ॥
candidates.translation: "What is the root, the source of all? What teachings hold for these times?
